C0278.title: Sentencing Issues in Web Crawler Crimes: Analysis of 88 Sample Cases
C0278.summary: In January 2023, China Court Network published an article analyzing 88 sample cases of web crawler crimes. It found that sentences in judicial practice were generally relatively lenient because crawler methods were not given sufficient weight alongside profit motives, while the amount involved played a key role and the social harm of crawler misuse was often underweighted.
